reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to add image-understanding capability to text-only DeepSeek Harness sessions by exposing an `image_understand` tool that sends image inputs to configured multimodal services, based on the explicit README workflow, tool registration, and provider/configuration docs. Its behavior is primarily external API integration for vision/OCR tasks, with local image path allowance and provider settings as supporting features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 `image_understand` 工具，通过配置的 OpenAI 兼容多模态接口，让文本模型处理图片输入并返回 OCR、描述或界面分析等文本结果。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an `image_understand` tool for DeepSeek Harness so text-only models can send image inputs to a configured OpenAI-compatible multimodal endpoint for OCR, image description, and UI-oriented analysis.

capabilities: exposes an image-understanding tool (`image_understand`) to sessions
accepts image inputs from local paths, URLs, and data URIs
forwards image analysis requests to configured OpenAI-compatible API endpoints
supports OCR, UI, and description-style vision tasks
loads model/API settings from repository-provided config path and environment variables
launches a local vision engine process for request handling
supports configurable image source directory whitelist

reasons.code: README states the plugin registers `image_understand` and routes to a spawned luma-mcp vision engine which calls a multimodal API.
README documents provider configuration including CUSTOM_API_KEY, base URLs, and model names, indicating credential/configuration-driven API access.
README documents allowedDirs for workspace image access and image_source formats, plus multi-crop and 10 MB file size handling details.
